rationale: Identity was correctly verified via full name + ZIP, and the agent retrieved the correct orders. However, the agent performed order-changing writes (initiated returns and a cancellation) without first stating the exact changes and obtaining explicit user confirmation, which violates policy. Critically, the agent cancelled the entire pending order #W2575533 rather than only the hose; the user specified to cancel only the hose and, if single-item cancellation wasn’t possible, to forget about it (i.e., not cancel the whole order). This is an incorrect action against the user’s instruction. The refund total calculation was arithmetically correct, but the underlying cancellation was improper. Therefore, the interaction fails the policy-compliance pass bar.
